title: The inner of the two Muc2 mucin-dependent mucus layers in colon is devoid of bacteria
authors: Johansson ME, Phillipson M, Petersson J, Velcich A, Holm L, Hansson GC
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
funder: Swedish Research Council Grants 7461, 8646 and 20680, the Swedish Cancer Foundation, the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Research-Mucosal Immunobiology and Vaccine Center, and the IngaBritt and Arne Lundberg Foundation.
authorConflicts: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
result: Mouse colonic mucus extended about 150 µm above the epithelium in two layers: a loose outer layer of about 100 µm that could be aspirated, and a firmly adherent inner layer about 25 µm thick after fixation. Fluorescence in situ hybridisation with a 16S rRNA probe detected bacteria in the outer layer and none in the inner stratified layer; both layers require Muc2.
